idea: A short spoken-only podcast about starting an independent creative project.

entries.title: Opening
entries.text:
Welcome to Independent Voices. Today we are looking at the first small decisions behind an independent creative project.

What do you want to make, and who do you want to share it with?

entries.title: Main story
entries.text:
Start with one clear idea. A small project gives you room to try something, listen to the response, and decide what to change.

In this section, add your own example or interview recording. Explain what happened, what you learned, and what you would do next.

entries.title: Closing
entries.text:
Choose one step you can take this week. It could be recording a conversation, writing a page, or sharing a first draft.

Thank you for listening. We will pick up the conversation next time.
